text:
maria: Quick doc sprint — want to tidy the mini hello quickstart: streamline auth section, consolidate the container deploy into one simple path, and update SDK snippets to SDK8. Who can own the PRs?

sam: I can take the auth section. Any breaking changes I should call out?

maria: thanks! main things: env var name is still REDWOOD_API_KEY but we changed the recommended var in code samples to REDWOOD_KEY last month — reconcile to REDWOOD_API_KEY. Also update token example to show `REDWOOD_API_KEY` + brief note about scopes.

jordan: I'll do the Docker/container example. want me to collapse both docker-compose and k8s into single "quick deploy" with a one-file container + `redwoodctl` example?

lee: fwiw the CI lint will fail if snippets use old `client.createSession()` shape. we moved to `new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: ... })` in SDK8.

sam: ok I'll swap those.

ci-bot: CI failed on branch docs/hello-auth-swap — snippet-lint: code_snippet_3 uses deprecated `client.createSession()` (line 12).

maria: @sam mind pushing a quick commit to fix that one? small patch in examples/node/auth.md.

sam: on it. pushing in 5.

sam: pushed. changed snippet to: 

```js
// node example
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate('Hello world');
```

maria: perfect. add a one-liner note about storing keys in KMS for enterprise.

jordan: dockerfile condensed to single stage, pushed PR. added `EXPOSE 8080` + `CMD [\"node\",\"server.js\"]` example. also included `redwoodctl deploy --local` snippet for quick dev deploy.

deploy-bot: Snapshot created for deployment preview — preview URL: https://preview.redwood.host/pr/4123

lee: I updated the quickstart checklist to mention `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env var name and link to console token page. Also removed duplicate table of contents entry.

sam: CI green on my PR now :tada:

maria: awesome. anything blocking a merge?

jordan: nothing from me. docs lint fixed.

lee: merging once CI passes on the combined PR. I'll squash the small typo commit.

maria: thanks team. after merge can someone add a one-sentence blurb to the release notes about the auth var rename and SDK8 snippet migration?

sam: I'll add the blurb.

maria: cool. closing the thread; ping if anything regresses.
